name: Scarecrow
about: A friendly scarecrow with a pumpkin head, watching over a little wheat field.

layers.name: Water and farmland
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig one block in the middle and fill it with water. Hoe the three rows around it into farmland. Leave the back and front rows as grass.

layers.name: Wheat, pumpkins and a post
layers.tip: Plant wheat seeds on the farmland. On the back row, put a pumpkin at each end and a fence post in the middle.

layers.name: Body
layers.tip: A hay bale on top of the post.

layers.name: Arms
layers.tip: Another hay bale, with two fences on each side for arms.

layers.name: Head
layers.tip: Use shears on a pumpkin to carve a face. Put it on top, facing the front.

layers.name: Hat
layers.tip: A dark oak slab makes a hat.
